name: verdict-unrecorded
why: Section 5's third verdict state in the queue. `unrecorded` is a review that happened and could not be recorded, because the reviewing identity was the PR's author or the merger - the ordinary case for a loop driven from a terminal. It is NOT a failure, so #1's ticket sits at `awaiting-review`/`review` exactly as an unreviewed one does, never at `changes-requested`/`resolve`; and it is NOT a merge, so the unlinked PR #201 still raises a `pr-review` row rather than dropping out of the queue. Only the wording differs, to say the PR needs an INDEPENDENT reviewer rather than a first one.

expected.detail: PR #201 awaits an independent reviewer: chore: no ticket
